summary: Version 1 compiles and passes validation and topology checks (no missing edges). The automatic Critic review scored it 0.93 with must_repair=false. It reproduces the six labelled points A, B, C, D, E, F; the segments A–D, A–B, B–C, C–D, D–E and D–F; and a partial arc centred at D (radius 280 px) through E, B, C and F. The unlabeled intersection point P was left unlabeled, as intended.
